items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: HP-style gauge on Base UI Meter sharing Progress geometry (framed 14 px track, solid cells over hairline ticks, whole-cell fill, smooth 240 ms clip on increase). low/critical add alert notches in the bottom frame padding and an alert frame; critical also paints the fill alert. Announced as a meter with aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. No original assets are used. v4: variant="dots" (opt-in; the hatched bar stays the default). v4 craft pass (breaking): `variant="dots"` is removed (hatched fill and dot columns replaced by the shared cell gauge); new prop `size`. Meter now imports `Gauge` from @yorha/progress.
